post.summary: Create Direct Sales Order from Quotation
post.description:
Create a Sales Order directly from an ACCEPTED Quotation without creating a Proforma Invoice.

Only ACCEPTED Quotations can be converted.

The customer must have at least one previous valid and fully paid Sales Invoice.

Business rules:
- quotation must exist
- quotation must be ACCEPTED
- quotation must not be deleted/cancelled
- customer must have at least one qualifying fully paid Sales Invoice
- quotation must not already have an active Sales Order
- Proforma Invoice is NOT required for this conversion
- resulting Sales Order status is DRAFT
- sourceQuotationId must be populated
- sourceProformaInvoiceId must be null for this flow

200.description: Return the complete Sales Order response.

400.description: Quotation is not ACCEPTED / Customer does not have a fully paid previous Sales Invoice / Sales Order already exists for quotation
